test: [INV-SCH-11] FSRS rows are keyed (item, surface) and each surface carries its own state
what: 猫 is introduced in a picture-select and the pack enumerates three accepted surfaces (ねこ, 猫, neko). Holding one FSRS row per ITEM gives a stored set with no per-member scheduling state, and the kana-only learner is shown a kanji nobody taught them.
measured: 2026-09-11. The three surfaces carry three distinct row keys; crediting the introduced one leaves the other two untouched; answering an un-introduced surface returns review_kind=uncredited with an uncreditedSurface anomaly and a byte-identical card.
